steps.title: Open on the Quart
steps.note: The watch screen: what waits for a decision, the pulse of the fleet, the bell. If nothing waits, it says so instead of showing an empty list.

steps.title: Settle a mandate
steps.note: Approve or refuse behind Face ID. The four conflicts the server can answer are handled explicitly, so a stale card never lies to you.

steps.title: Follow a team
steps.note: Read a thread as a document, open a sub-agent, send an instruction to the lead, or dictate it with the phone's own speech recognition.

steps.title: Keep the machines up
steps.note: Gauges with thresholds, five-hour and seven-day quotas, and a wake button when the PC is asleep.
